title: Abnormal-aware Multi-person Evaluation System with Improved Fuzzy Weighting
reasoning: The paper aims to create a fairer and more equitable evaluation system, which are ethical concepts. However, the work's primary focus is on developing and applying mathematical and statistical methods (like fuzzy weighting and anomaly detection) to reduce human subjectivity. It does not evaluate or benchmark morals, ethics, or faith as a subject of study itself, but rather uses technical means to achieve an ethically desirable outcome.
